August has arrived, and deals like AirPods Pro 3 for $50 off, AirPods Max 2 for $100 off, and AirTag 2 at a historic low are still going strong. But today’s 9to5Toys "Midday Roundup" headline is the M5 MacBook Air — we’ve spotted a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, while the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently offering up to $300 off across multiple configurations, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details here). These deals join nearly $100 off various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest black Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable for just $18, and a chance to grab the transparent red Beats Solo Buds at a low $40. Details below.

Best Buy launches August Back to School deals: Apple products, smart TVs starting from $80, dorm upgrades, and more

Official Apple Refurbished Store now selling M5 MacBook Air at the lowest prices, with up to $300 off

The latest round of price hikes on the MacBook lineup has already taken effect at retail, and while we’ve tracked deals with up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering the best discounts on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We’ve previously highlighted the lowest-priced base models from reputable sources, but you can also pick up the 24GB 15-inch model in Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue for $300 off retail at the store.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is currently selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,699 with free shipping. As noted above, this deal applies to all four colors: Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This is a MacBook Air with a $1,900 price tag, and right now every configuration is going for over $1,999 on Amazon.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new) — $300 off

Today’s Apple refurbished deal brings the price of this machine back to its old pricing and offers the best discount we’ve seen since the price hike took effect. It looks like these new MSRPs are here to stay through the year, and likely even longer. So while this isn’t the all-time low price we’ve tracked, it’s definitely a money-saving opportunity worth grabbing for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year — chances are we won’t see these kinds of prices on the new MacBook Air lineup again until later in 2027.

Browse all MacBook deals at the Apple Refurbished Store now — use the filters on the left side of the page to select your desired model.

The cheapest 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air is $200 off today

Ongoing: Amazon offering massive savings up to $500 off on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro today

MacBook prices just went up, but Amazon is still offering massive discounts up to $500 off on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning. This is very close to the best prices we saw before the price hikes took effect. Details below.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Considering this machine is now priced at $2,999 at Apple and elsewhere, this works out to a solid $500 off. This deal applies to Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best deal we’ve seen on M5 Pro models since the major retailer price hikes took effect.

Prior to this, Amazon’s best discount on this machine was $300, but this time it’s an extra $200 off.

This still doesn’t match the prices we tracked on this configuration before the official price hikes, but c’est la vie — it is what it is. All things considered, and remembering that this machine only got a massive price hike about a month ago, this deal is just $100 off from the lowest price we’ve ever seen on this M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models now nearly $100 off at Amazon

Update: As we expected, Amazon has now also lowered prices on some other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium case model with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band, with discounts nearing $100. Details below.

While the Series 11 lineup has seen steady deals, just like the start of August, discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been rarer. But this morning we spotted Amazon selling the black Ultra 3 with the black "One Size Fits Most" Ocean Band at nearly $100 off.

Amazon is currently selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the black Ocean Band for $699.99 with free shipping.

Originally $799, this nearly $100 discount is the best deal on a new unit we can find from a reputable retailer.

Aside from a brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this is one of the best deals of the year and one of the few times we’ve seen a notable price drop on Amazon.

As of writing, the black model with the Ocean Band is the only configuration enjoying a substantial discount. But if this deal follows the pattern of the last one, we’ll likely see other color configurations drop in price throughout the day and week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

If it’s the Series 11 you’re after, you can grab one for well below those prices right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Latest black Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable drops back to all-time low $18 with Prime shipping ($40% off)

Score transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

We were quite impressed with the built-in battery life on the Solo Buds — this is the most affordable current-generation Beats wireless earbuds you can buy. But at $80 retail and typically $70 on Amazon, it’s an even sweeter deal if you can grab them for just $41 with free shipping from Best Buy. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals here, and more on the Solo Buds offer below.

Best Buy is currently selling "excellent condition" open-box transparent red Beats Solo Buds for $40.99 with free shipping. That’s nearly half off the suggested retail price and well below Amazon’s $70 for new units.

  • Looks and works like new.
  • Comes with all parts and accessories. Packaging may be different or there may be no packaging.

You are indeed looking at a more entry-level pair of earbuds, but what we’re looking at is a current-generation pair from the Apple brand for just $41.

As noted above, we tested them in person and confirmed the earbuds’ built-in battery delivers up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. While it’s not a wireless charging case with a battery, for most users the battery life is more than sufficient at $41. Other features include one-touch pairing, custom microphones with "advanced noise-learning algorithms" for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
